summary: Short kerb at a bus zone and driveway, with homes 5-10 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 5 m and 10 m from kerb

best_section.where: Hawken Drive south kerb beside the bus stop, opposite the traffic island

drivers.seclusion: Homes at 5 m, 10 m and 11 m of the stretch, with house frontages immediately behind the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb on a through road; the stretch is short (26 m) and includes bus zone signage and driveways.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a painted island opposite.
drivers.convention: Bus zone and 2P resident-permit signs; one or two cars parked nearby.

flags: Bus zone signs on the stretch
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the south-west side.
